scope: Finite original-x86 versus canonical source grid query, real row-producer comparison and explicit source-only unsupported-path guards.
abi: cdecl DWORD(signed DWORD x, signed DWORD y, signed DWORD z, DWORD step); caller masks result to low WORD
side_effects: Native body has no stores to globals/data; candidate reads the shared sequence owner only. Fixture snapshots both sequence instances, temporarily writes and restores two native/source coefficient words for live-alias differential cases, then verifies the query itself changed neither sequence nor reconstructed row arrays. Step is unused.
data_reads: 0x70e0c WORD offset lane and 0x70e2c WORD base-offset lane, indexed by clamped layer
0x70dcc row-pointer DWORD lane, indexed by clamped layer
selected grid DWORD, whose top seven bits select a relative header record through the DWORD pointer at 0x70d40
packed WORD and signed sample byte in the selected header record
first coefficient lane 0x5e0d0 + index*16: measured indices 0..6 use candidate-owned scalar values and 7..13 alias g_actor_group_sequence_5e138
fourth coefficient lane 0x5e0dc + nibble*16: measured indices 0..5 use candidate-owned scalar values and 6..12 alias g_actor_group_sequence_5e138
unknowns: The original routine has no index guard. Source data supports first-lane indices 0..13 and fourth-lane indices 0..12; indices outside these measured views explicitly call eng1_incomplete_behavior. The real packed high-byte caller domain remains unknown, so no native full-extent claim is made.
The header pointer has no measured allocation extent, so the candidate guards null but does not claim arbitrary malformed header safety.
The row-pointer data allocation extent depends on the real row producer inputs; tests cover positive width 4 and row extent 4 only.
Only low-WORD return equality is claimed because caller 0x2a170 masks the native EAX result; no full DWORD return equivalence is claimed.
The function-map 368-byte span includes ten trailing NOPs and start extent is not proven; no function-boundary or whole-image claim is made.

canonical_adjustments: Native coefficient storage is writable .data; canonical prefix remains mutable and coefficient reads are volatile DWORDs. Existing sequence is read through its sole source owner; no copied overlap or original production dispatch.
limits: Only low-WORD return behavior is validated. Supported coefficient first lanes0..13 and fourth lanes0..12 are measured views, not full capacity or caller-domain proof. Unsupported reads report exact requested native RVA and fail. Dynamic row/header allocation extents remain unproven.
